description: Replace silent ADD-all fallback with fail-closed behavior. Currently, when snapshot is unavailable in placement_manifest.py lines 387-413, the system returns an empty repository index and logs a warning, causing all candidates to receive ADD action (duplicate prevention disabled). Change this to raise RepositoryEvidenceBlocked exception when snapshot is unavailable or unloadable, forcing explicit handling rather than silent degradation.
steps: 1. Read services/project-ai/app/intake/placement_manifest.py lines 380-415 to confirm the current fallback behavior (_build_repository_index method)
2. Import RepositoryEvidenceBlocked from app.contracts.repository_intelligence (already used elsewhere in codebase per grep results)

3. Replace the two warning-and-return-empty-list blocks (lines 387-395 for missing snapshot_path, lines 396-413 for failed load) with raise RepositoryEvidenceBlocked with descriptive messages: 'Snapshot path not provided - cannot perform duplicate prevention' and 'Failed to load snapshot from {path}: {error} - cannot perform duplicate prevention'
4. Update any calling code that expects empty list to handle the exception (check generate_manifest method in same file for try-except wrapping)
acceptance_criteria: When snapshot_path is None, _build_repository_index raises RepositoryEvidenceBlocked
When snapshot file is missing or unloadable, _build_repository_index raises RepositoryEvidenceBlocked with the underlying error details
Exception messages clearly state the fail-closed policy reason
No code paths silently return empty repository index on snapshot errors
verification: Run pytest services/project-ai/tests/unit/test_artifact_policy.py -v to confirm existing tests still pass
Run pytest services/project-ai/tests/unit/test_placement_manifest.py -v if it exists to check for regressions
Manually verify no other callers of _build_repository_index exist: grep -r '_build_repository_index' services/project-ai/app/
